causal_rows.subject: 737th movement ownership
causal_rows.measured_fact: n40 completed turns 137/138/139: arbih_737th_muslim_light is eligible, first handled by offensive, emits dig_in, and emits no ordinary attack/movement. Post-turn location remains Gornja Rovna; destinations are null, Udurlije, Udurlije.
causal_rows.hypothesis: A later phase can mutate movement state or orders. Front distribution, drift recall, elite-loan ticking and elite repair are source-supported candidate families; none is attributed to the 737th.
causal_rows.missing_evidence: Separate movement_state and movement_order before/after each relevant post-ordinary-pass phase, destination/status/stance and reported ownership provenance, then selected branch and its inputs. Temporal mv_destinations uses movement state first and order fallback; it does not identify which supplied Udurlije.
causal_rows.smallest_discriminator: First prepare an opt-in named-actor observer of movement state AND orders before/after each relevant post-ordinary-pass phase at completed t137–139. Capture phase identity, destination/status/stance and ownership provenance where available; mark absent fields unreported. A focused fixture validates observer coverage and noninterference. Once a mutation boundary is measured, instrument that branch. No campaign is authorized by this proposal.
